project.name: Hero: Vandoliers Are Turning Cowpunk Into an Honesty Machine

data.label: Style
data.name: Comic Ink + Raw Punk Energy
data.description: Heavy ink illustration. Bold black outlines, high contrast chiaroscuro with deep blacks and stark highlights. Cel-shaded shadows, graphic shapes. High contrast B&W with earth tone pops (brown, rust, ochre). Hand-drawn comic book aesthetic with raw, DIY energy. Influenced by Los Bros Hernandez and Paul Pope. NOT photorealistic. Edge-to-edge composition.

data.label: Setting
data.description: Underground rock club, small venue stage, DIY show space with raw lighting

data.label: Action
data.content: Packed Texas roadhouse stage at night, six-piece country-punk band in motion, singer at center mic in a western shirt under harsh white spotlight, fiddle and trumpet flanking the stage, neon beer signs and dancehall walls behind them, crowd pressed close, sense of confession turning into communion, heavy ink linework, stark chiaroscuro, black-and-white with dusty red and amber accents, no text

data.label: Negative
data.content: photorealistic, photography, soft gradients, airbrushed, fedoras, 1940s detective imagery, film noir clichés, blurry, text, watermark, stock photo, over-rendered, plastic-looking, polished, corporate, arena rock, mainstream pop
